jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a) inventory: NEK Choice School District (formed 2017 as the Northeast Kingdom Choice Unified School District), a unified union district in the Essex North Supervisory Union (member towns: Bloomfield, Brunswick, East Haven, Granby, Guildhall, Kirby, Lemington, Maidstone, Norton, Victory). Non-operating: tuitions all students PK-12.
Town of Maidstone NEK Choice page (official): the 2017 formation and the ENSU assignment.

sources.note: NEK Choice SD: eleven directors, residency allocated one per member town except Kirby with two, elected by all voters of the district (modified at-large, formation articles Art. I). NO memberships are minted yet -- see the second source note. NEK Choice formation warning to Guildhall voters, March 7, 2017 (official town document), Articles of Agreement Art. I: representation "one member from each of the forming districts, except for Kirby, which will have two members"; "Each member of the board shall be elected by a vote of all the voters in all the towns forming the unified school district" -- modified at-large. Art. II elects eleven directors. The district does not operate any schools (tuition PK-12).

NEK Choice board minutes, September 21, 2023 (ENSU document system) -- the newest minutes located; the December 15, 2022 minutes name nine members. NO memberships are minted: no current roster document exists in any located official source (missing: an ENSU-published roster or any 2025-2026 minutes), no member's town is published, and the two members corroborated as serving in 2026 (Miles Etter, Sharon Ellingwood-White, in January/May 2026 legislative hearings on the district's own bill, Act 124) rest on lead-grade carriers -- the Kingdom East / Mount Ascutney standard is applied and all memberships are held.
